chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Mihzam, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a mukatab who dies while he has children, and he said:

"If a condition had been stipulated against him, then his children are slaves. But if no such condition had been stipulated against him, his children must strive in their father's contract of manumission, and they are freed when they complete the payment."

key_terms.اشْتُرِطَ: a condition was stipulated in the contract
key_terms.الْمُكَاتَبِ: a slave under a contractual agreement of emancipation through payment

ai.seo_question: What happens to the children of a mukatab if he dies before completing his contract of emancipation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a mukatab who dies leaving children. Their status depends on whether a binding condition had been stipulated in the manumission contract: if it had, they remain enslaved; if not, they continue fulfilling their father's contract until they are freed.
